Rolling the web deployment back one revision would revert the changes made in the last update. The blast radius analysis shows that the web deployment is contained within the demo namespace, and there are several other resources in the same namespace that may be affected by the rollback, including a ReplicaSet and a ServiceAccount. Additionally, there are other namespaces, such as kube-system, data, and code2k8s-builds, that contain resources that may be impacted by the rollback. The analysis also shows that there are several ServiceAccounts and Secrets in various namespaces that may be affected. 

To understand the full impact of the rollback, it's recommended to review the changes made in the last update and assess the dependencies between the web deployment and other resources in the cluster.
